name: recall
label: Recall
tagline: Flashcards that come back when due

help.about: Flashcards that come back when they are due. Rate each answer Again, Hard, Good or Easy and the scheduler picks when you see the card next.

manifest.summary: Flashcards scheduled with FSRS (shared/forge_fsrs.py, the same scheduler Kotoba uses): each answer (Again, Hard, Good, Easy) sets when the card comes back. Cards are written on the page or imported from Study Companion: every question in its question banks (answer and worked steps on the back) and any line in its notes written as front :: back. One deck per course. recall.json is the registry of sources; recall_core.IMPORTERS has one function per kind.
